run_normal_map_inference: run batch inference on images using a normal map estimation model checkpoint
run_model_warmup: run warmup_model to pre-compile the model with dummy bfloat16 inputs on CUDA
run_inference_model: run inference_model to perform forward pass on image batches and return CPU results
run_img_save_and_viz: run img_save_and_viz to save normalized normal maps as numpy and visualize side by side
run_load_model: run load_model to load a checkpoint as TorchScript or TorchExport module
